follow-up time: The study followed women from the first to the third trimester of pregnancy.
exposure: presence or absence of premature rupture of membranes
cohort: This study involved 488 singleton pregnant women aged 18-44 years, including 244 cases of spontaneous preterm birth and 244 controls, participating in the Beijing Birth Cohort Study (BBCS) from 2018 to 2020.
finding: Maternal manganese levels were significantly higher in the third trimester than those in the first trimester, and the risk of spontaneous preterm birth was increased in women with the highest manganese levels in the third trimester, especially in normal-weight women or those without premature rupture of membranes.
